name: telemetry-backup-agent
description: D19 (Cabin Platform Decisions artifact), Option B: an independent MQTT log-shipping side-car. Subscribes directly to the same broker cabin-backend does and appends every message verbatim to /storage, completely decoupled from cabin-backend's own health -- the 2026-09-13 Zigbee mesh outage was only recoverable because Zigbee2MQTT's own docker logs happened to retain the window; this makes that recovery path deliberate instead of lucky, and covers every topic, not just Zigbee's. See docs/MAINTENANCE.md's D19 write-up for the full incident and design rationale.
